title: Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Sets for Incomplete Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.31329v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attribute reduction in incomplete information systems is difficult because missing values break the equivalence-class structure of rough set theory. We propose the Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Set (COFRS) model. Each object is described by its set of present attributes. The similarity of two objects is a weighted overlap on the attributes present in both, divided by the fixed number of attributes |A| instead of the size of their union, so missing values are penalised globally and are not matched as wildcards. From this similarity we define a soft dependency degree based on weighted granule consistency, and we search for reducts by greedy backward elimination in O(|U|^2 |A|^2) time. We show that the relation is symmetric and non-reflexive, that the dependency degree is not monotone, and we give a sufficient condition under which monotonicity holds. translated_title: 面向不完整数据的保守重叠模糊粗糙集
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.31329v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在不完整信息系统中进行属性约减十分困难，因为缺失值破坏了粗糙集理论的等价类结构。我们提出了保守重叠模糊粗糙集（COFRS）模型。每个对象由其存在的属性集合来描述。两个对象的相似度是在两者共同存在的属性上的加权重叠，除以固定的属性数量 |A| 而非其并集的大小，因此缺失值被全局性地惩罚，而不会被当作通配符来匹配。基于该相似度，我们定义了基于加权粒一致性的软依赖度，并通过时间复杂度为 O(|U|^2 |A|^2) 的贪心反向消除方法来搜索约减。我们证明了该关系是对称且非自反的，依赖度并不满足单调性，并给出了单调性成立的充分条件。在缺失率介于 0.15% 到 20.46% 的 11 个 UCI 基准数据集上，COFRS 给出了最小的（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出保守重叠模糊粗糙集（COFRS）模型，通过对共同存在属性进行加权重叠、全局惩罚缺失值的相似度定义及基于加权粒一致性的软依赖度，实现了不完整数据上高效且稳健的属性约减。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Set (COFRS) model, which enables efficient attribute reduction on incomplete data by using a weighted-overlap similarity that globally penalizes missing values and a soft dependency degree based on weighted granule consistency.
